text:
incident-bot: Pager: high p95 token latency detected on prod-cluster-1. Queue growth is 4x baseline, multiple streams stalled.
maria: Oncall maria here, looking at ingress queues and mux metrics. Streaming connection count spiked around 14:02 UTC.
aj: Could be the new streaming multiplexor rollout. I see a large bump in open SSEs and a drop in effective token throughput.
noah: Confirmed. GPU utilization steady, but request processing time increased — backpressure in the mux layer. KV cache miss rate also up.
maria: Symptom summary: first-token latency elevated, clients waiting for first chunk, backlog >10k requests, downstream timeouts starting.
emily: CS reports multiple tenants hit by long wait times and support tickets coming in.
aj: Mitigation suggestion: flip streaming push off for public-hosted clusters so clients fallback to short-polling. Keep behavior for dedicated customers unchanged for now.
maria: Agree. Plan: toggle feature.streaming_push=false in prod for public clusters for 5-15 minutes, watch p95, then re-enable gradually.
noah: I'll execute the toggle via deploy-bot. Command: 
```bash
deploy-bot toggle feature.streaming_push --env=prod --value=false --reason='mitigate mux latency spike'
```
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Starting rollout to prod-usw2 canary group.
deploy-bot: Change applied: canary -> 20% of public nodes.
maria: Observing metrics: request queue depth dropping within 60-120s, streaming connection count decreasing, p95 improving.
support-beth: Support: preparing proactive customer note that we're temporarily switching streaming to polling to stabilize responsiveness.
aj: After 5 minutes if p95 < 250ms we hold and then re-enable streaming to a small canary (5-10%) with conservative batching and KV cache warming.
noah: Also proposing temporary quota uplift for high-tier dedicated customers to prevent 429 cascades: set-quota-customer --id=dedicated-* --burst=2x
maria: Handing incident to oncall-jake for monitoring and next steps. Jake, please escalate if we see error rate >1% or p95 >500ms for 2+ minutes.
jake: Taking over. I have dashboards up, alert hooks configured. Running the rollback playbook if we go outside thresholds.
maria: Postmortem owner: aj. Include timeline, root cause hypothesis (mux backpressure + cache thrash), and remediation (backpressure controls, better canary ramp, KV cache improvements).
emily: CS will draft the customer communication; tag me when streaming is re-enabled so I can update customers.
jake: At +7min from toggle: p95 at ~180ms, error rate 0.1%, queue sizes normalized. Holding state.
deploy-bot: Toggle request: enable feature.streaming_push=true for canary group.
deploy-bot: Change applied to canary. Observing.
jake: Canary looks healthy after 4 minutes. Rolling to 50% canary with monitoring window 10 minutes.
support-beth: Outbound update sent to affected tenants. Incident ticket INC-2065432 created.
maria: Closing the live mitigation. We'll keep monitoring for the next hour and collect logs for the postmortem. Great coordination, folks. :thumbsup:
